task_goal: Try a fictional time-management demo without email, phone, or calendar binding, and without creating real schedule items.
judge_summary: X visibly offered a no-registration guest experience and explained temporary sample data, but ended with '游客体验当前未开放'. Y accurately showed only the available registration form, which requires an account and does not meet the no-account goal. Neither screenshot pair completes the task; calendar-free support is not established.

mapping_unblinded_after_judgment.X: reconstructed baseline: guest option was forced visible for capture; POST response reproduced the actual backend's disabled message
mapping_unblinded_after_judgment.Y: candidate: actual backend auth options false/true hide guest and show registration

validity_limitations: The baseline screenshot is a controlled reconstruction, not a new browser run of the historical build.
Both versions visibly fail the requested task; preference is not evidence of successful task completion.
The judge saw screenshots only and did not interact with the form.
No human participant or numeric satisfaction survey was used.
decision: Do not claim an overall task-UX win. Keep backend-driven capability rendering as a truthfulness/correctness fix, while recording the no-account demo capability as unresolved; do not silently enable guest account creation because the backend configuration is explicitly false.
